bootstrap.help:
Usage: control bootstrap [--target HOST_OR_GROUP] [Ansible options]
Choose targets by number, inventory name or group. Separate multiple targets with commas. Ansible patterns are supported.
--limit/-l supplies an initial selection. --list-hosts previews the selected hosts.

bootstrap.selection_help:
Enter numbers, inventory names or groups separated by commas.
Examples: 1,3 | example-server | dmz_hosts | all_linux_systems
Enter q to quit. A blank selection without a default cancels.
